name: Create diagrams and flowcharts for various processes
description: Users asked for the creation of diverse visual diagrams, flowcharts, and conceptual maps to represent processes, algorithms, organizational structures, and theoretical models across various domains such as engineering, education, and business. They frequently specified output formats like ASCII, Mermaid, or SVG, or requested descriptions suitable for manual drawing in software applications.
